semantic_limitations_observed: Some retained references shift offsets because earlier text changes; those shifts do not imply new insertion.
Inserted pairs can contain both inherited and newly added occurrences.
A same-named external provider and generic navigation titles satisfy the lexical rule without establishing an intentional wiki-page reference.

method: Reload pinned release; resolve selected target/parent records; check all reported spans/excerpts against source text; inspect character-level diff operations and nearby inert text. No links followed or content executed. Also verify target/parent/source record hashes and strict nonoverlap source and parent time conditions.
limitations: AI assistance is part of this implementation session; it is not an independent human validation or a ground-truth assessment.
Diff checks reuse the specified SequenceMatcher algorithm and do not establish a unique edit history.
Pass denotes compliance with the frozen literal extraction rule, not semantic relevance, authorship, exposure, copying, or source use.
Twenty selected pairs do not establish extraction precision or recall over the export.
Observed handles remain distinct from stable run identities; all candidate source-request, delivery and context support remains unavailable.
